Unnamed: 2: Aurora kinase inhibitor, JAK2 inhibitor (could have usage in myeloproliferative disorders)
Phase II pivotal study in CML
n=270 with resistant CML, Ph+ ALL with BCR-ABL T315I mutation.
CML patients all pretreated with Glivec and Tasigna/Sprycel
9 patients had T315I mutation. 8 had hematological and/or cytogenetic response. 6 patients without mutation did not respond.
2 patients with Ph+ ALL had responses
6/9 patients with MPD with V617F activating mutation in JAK2 had clinical responses
